summary.text: HIPKNITSHOP AS is a private limited company registered in Bodø, founded 2018-01-01. HIPKNITSHOP AS designs and produces clothing and patterns, prepares and sells knitting patterns and recipes, and sells yarn, patterns and knitting accessories. The company also produces booklets/books and gift items and other products and services within knitting and handcraft, and offers workshops, courses, teaching and photography. Its main industry code is 14.100: manufacture of knitted and crocheted apparel. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 9 318 917 NOK and the annual result was -353 050 NOK; operating income was down from 11 371 851 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 410 207 NOK in 2024 to -353 050 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 2 568 693 NOK in 2024 to 1 912 244 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Catharina Ilstad (daglig leder and styrets leder). Its verified website is hipknitshop.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube profiles. Recent changes in the register: employees set to 9 on 2026-10-14.
